response.description:
Model router in Microsoft Foundry can use your existing model deployments to serve routed requests, in public preview. This helps you use capacity you already have while model router selects a model for each request.After selecting a model, model router first tries your eligible provisioned throughput (PTU) deployment for an OpenAI model, then your eligible pay-as-you-go deployment, and then router-managed capacity. It moves to the next option when no eligible deployment is available at that step or a deployment returns a retryable error.To use your deployment, deploy the exact model name and version from the supported model pool in the same Foundry resource. PTU support applies to OpenAI models; pay-as-you-go support applies to models across the pool. For Data Zone Standard model router deployments, only Data Zone deployments are eligible.When your PTU deployment serves a request, the model router routing fee applies in addition to your existing PTU charges. When your pay-as-you-go deployment serves it, its usage charges and the routing fee apply.Learn more: From model choice to your durable
